I am an old woman farming with very limited money, so on this nuts plot I will keep things simple and use mostly the seed I normally save or get locally. Here in Mtwara we depend on the rains, and for this intercropped field I do not expect to buy chemical fertilizer or irrigation. My household will do most of the work ourselves, though I may hire a few labor days if we need help with clearing or weeding.
